_comment: English body for deepl-pro; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Powered by DeepL’s own translation models; model parameters are not public. Glossary and document translation vary by tier.
axes.runtime: Available through web, desktop app and API; translation happens in DeepL’s cloud.
axes.local_files: Supports document translation with partial layout preservation; local files must be uploaded and cannot be batch-scanned from a directory.
axes.background: Single documents return immediately and document jobs run within a session; there is no background agent that survives shutdown. Tasks are triggered per request and no resident agent remains.
axes.tools: Glossaries, document translation, API and browser extensions; can integrate with CAT tools and internal systems.
axes.context: Context is mainly the current text, glossary and document; cross-project memory is limited. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Pro data processing and retention terms follow the contract; glossaries and translation memory may contain client-sensitive content.
axes.fit: Fits: technical documentation, assisted contract translation and teams that need terminology consistency. Does not fit: replacing legal review or creative localisation.
